name: yui_aux_0001
statement: ∀ (W : Submodule K (Reduction.VK K M)) (f g : Module.End K (Reduction.VK K M)), (Reduction.stable W f → Reduction.stable W g → Reduction.stable W (f * g)) ∧ (Reduction.stable W f → ∀ c : K, Reduction.stable W (c • f)) ∧ (Reduction.stable W f → ∀ r : ℕ, Reduction.stable W (f ^ r))
proof:
intro W f g
have hmul : ∀ (a b : Module.End K (Reduction.VK K M)), Reduction.stable W a → Reduction.stable W b → Reduction.stable W (a * b) := by
  intro a b ha hb w hw
  exact ha (b w) (hb w hw)
refine ⟨hmul f g, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro hf c w hw
  exact W.smul_mem c (hf w hw)
· intro hf r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      intro w hw
      simpa only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply] using hw
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact hmul (f ^ r) f ih hf
